segments.sn17.23:1.3: saddhā, bhikkhave, upāsikā ekaputtakaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya –
segments.sn17.23:1.4: ‘tādiso, tāta, bhavāhi yādiso citto ca gahapati hatthako ca āḷavako’ti.
segments.sn17.23:1.5: Esā, bhikkhave, tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ, yadidaṃ citto ca gahapati hatthako ca āḷavako.
segments.sn17.23:1.6: Sace kho tvaṃ, tāta, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajasi;
segments.sn17.23:1.8: Esā, bhikkhave, tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, yadidaṃ sāriputtamoggalānā.
segments.sn17.23:1.9: Mā ca kho tvaṃ, tāta, sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātūti.
segments.sn17.23:1.10: Tañce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti, so tassa hoti antarāyāya.
segments.sn17.23:1.11: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …
